title: .NET Add support for web export using static LibGodot
key_points: PR serves as an alternative to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106125.
Uses static LibGodot to link Godot as a library for web export.
A huge portion of this PR was adding LibGodot support to web platform and figuring out a way to pass a static library to the final step.
LibGodot setup itself doesn't use the module mono and instead uses a simple interface written natively in C#.
This works with JS import and export, single-threaded and multi-threaded builds, .NET 9 and .NET 10.
limitations: It will force the support for Emscripten 3.1.56 until C# Emscripten is updated.
Currently it is not a problem, but CoreCLR also uses `Object` without namespace, so it causes duplicate symbols for `Object` vtable.
asserts: This PR adds support for web export using static LibGodot library in .NET platform.
scope: Adds web export functionality to Godot engine using .NET and static LibGodot library.
